checks.name: browser-safe acceptance executes twelve isolated integration checks without session access
acceptance cancellation does not claim a complete pass
exact values preserve large integers and field/quotient distinctions
rational enclosures and statistical estimates have different immutable meanings
canonical JSON rejects silent loss and hashes every required context dimension
all four fixtures run with validated envelopes and separate verification algorithms
real worker executes the same source with actual message-driven progress
missing finite scope, invalid budgets and unsafe exact integers are rejected before running
p-adic precision loss requests the extra digit and exact lifts refine only when available
cache respects source/precision/assumption changes and immutable result scope
cancel → checkpoint → fresh engine resume reproduces the exact finite result
operation exhaustion keeps a valid checkpoint and can resume within increased caps
tampered checkpoint integrity or forged completed prefix cannot become a result
observation bundle replays in a fresh session and never executes supplied sources
unsupported adapter and input caps return explicit bounded failure
queue has bounded concurrency and concurrent duplicate IDs cannot overwrite jobs
every complete starter contract validates and has a versioned JSON Schema
canonical JSON is stable and exact integers must use strings beyond IEEE-754 range
finite queries require bounds, preserve huge integer strings and reject infinite completeness claims
a CW complex or finite p-adic quotient cannot be renamed into a proved prism
general G contracts demand global form, representation, dimension and explicit embedding
PDE paper, illustrative model, manufactured force and bounded time are disjoint contracts
observations report lost information and scalar marginals cannot become connections
a generic result cannot issue formal/theorem authority or turn statistics into rigorous intervals
migration uses actual existing extension bundle and preserves legacy IDs, values, grades and input object
baseline hash and exact starting version are enforced
assumption edits stale only reachable claims and interpretations, preserving independent prime computation
USER_AXIOM origin survives revisions and cannot be smuggled into an unconditional target indirectly
dependency cycles and plain metadata certificates are rejected atomically
finite-field Weil RH and a finite/channel observation do not close global conjectures
live receipt identity is checked and serialized copies are only historical audit references
content references and input revisions cannot be rebound to mismatched hashes
reusing a historical assumption revision leaves the recomputed interpretation stale
export/import round-trip preserves exact mathematical payloads and legacy grades, quarantines current trust
tampering is caught at bundle, baseline and payload levels
USER_AXIOM cannot be hidden in an assumption ledger or a malformed namespace
plain JSON and nested checkpoints cannot revive serialized proof authority
all four actual adapters bind installed source, finite target, request and freshly verified result in one namespace
actual registered model reference is preserved and incompatible edited prime bounds are rejected
unknown assumptions and forged installed-worker manifests cannot produce a prepared job
finite arithmetic adapters reject relabeled YM/PDE/prism targets and stale generated operand contexts
assumption revision while a job runs prevents saving a stale interpretation and does not mutate the session
modified request or fabricated result values fail before save
all five shipped scopes recheck exact source bindings and get a branded local receipt
single source character change cannot reuse a previous kernel audit
one supplied job hash edit is rejected even with unchanged source
changed axiom text makes the associated conditional proof stale
delta context change is bound even when the source editor has not yet changed
target declaration and runtime digest are part of the audit identity
an imported audit with a fabricated authority ID cannot self-certify
editing imported audit exit code, target type, axioms or source hash fails the immutable digest
no audit or arbitrary Lean source creates no compiler claim
serialized and forged receipts have no runtime authority
same-ID or blank semantic metadata cannot borrow a live proof receipt
the explicit-hypothesis real theorem is displayed conditional even without custom axioms
a source bundle export requires fresh matching after a JSON round trip
custom axioms cannot be requested at an unconditional or exact-finite grade
reachable cycles are rejected with the cycle path
unrelated user axioms do not contaminate a disjoint claim closure
a literature link and an open conjecture do not close a kernel proof
renaming the desired theorem as an identical assumption leaves the research gate open
dependency graph malformed edges, duplicate IDs and missing hypotheses are rejected
source traversal, duplicate files and nonfinite metadata are rejected before hashing
canonical digests ignore object property order but preserve exact integer strings
shipped source text, raw Lean logs and negative controls match files actually checked
full imported artifact closure is pinned outside the compact browser payload
exact no-axiom fixture and user-axiom conditional fixture remain separately classified
bounded tools validate arguments before all effects; source status is not proof issuance
registration-only native surface works; repeated setup and cleanup affect owned registrations only
failed registration releases only this setup; no polyfill or broad origin exposure
dispose during asynchronous registration cannot leave late owned tools
